provider.existingDefinition: open-sse/providers/registry/veoaifree-web.js: endpoint, alias, noAuth, video service kind and both models already present; no definition addition needed
provider.connectionModes: Preserve existing connections. Anonymous is supported. Selected providerSpecificData.cookie / wordpress_logged_in* then apiKey can supply a WordPress session; OAuth tokens are never converted to cookies or bearer headers. No global session cache. Selected credential proxy options are retained.

endpoints.nonce: GET https://veoaifree.com; User-Agent and Referer; no Cookie (source behavior); merge Set-Cookie into this call's selected session
endpoints.submit: POST https://veoaifree.com/wp-admin/admin-ajax.php; application/x-www-form-urlencoded; action=veo_video_generator, nonce, prompt, totalVariations=1, aspectRatio, actionType=full-video-generate
endpoints.poll: POST same AJAX endpoint; action=veo_video_generator, nonce, sceneData, actionType=final-video-results
endpoints.auth: Registry none/none; optional selected WordPress Cookie only on AJAX requests; Origin https://veoaifree.com and Referer https://veoaifree.com/; no Authorization
endpoints.discovery: Static source registry models veo and seedance; no dynamic model discovery endpoint exists in the pinned source. Nonce acquisition is dynamic session setup, not model discovery.
endpoints.artifacts: Return the first public HTTPS URL without downloading. No cookies or authorization sent to artifacts. No MP4 or content-type claim. Literal private/reserved hosts rejected using local isBlockedHost. No DNS lookup needed because no artifact fetch occurs.

integration.handler: open-sse/handlers/videoGenerationCore.js: generateWithAdapter consumes generate({model,body,credentials,signal,log}); success response/accounting and error acceptedJob
integration.futureRegistration: Serial registration can import the default adapter into open-sse/handlers/videoProviders/index.js under veoaifree-web and veo-free; inspect/remove the legacy executor fallback separately. No production import added here.
integration.tests: Only the isolated staging registration boundary describe block depends on absence from the shared adapter registry.

subset.inputs: text prompt, models veo or seedance, n=1, stream=false, response_format=url; aspect_ratio or size must be VIDEO_ASPECT_RATIO_LANDSCAPE or VIDEO_ASPECT_RATIO_PORTRAIT; conflicting values rejected
subset.outputs: URL only, no download/base64/MP4 verification; source native base64 artifact behavior deliberately not advertised
subset.limits: 10,000 character prompt, 64 KiB upstream text, 30 s per network-and-body call, 660 s total including polling, 30 polls 20 s apart; test options can reduce bounds
subset.accounting: Unknown cost and duration; one returned video only on success. Any error after invoking submit retains acceptedJob conservatively, even explicit provider refusal. No automatic replay or credential rotation; connection identity stays with the caller.
